source_full_text: Ah, true son of your father cried the queen if only I might embrace you and call you son! Forgive me, my lord and husband she added, turning to the king, For trying to find out the truth in this way. Do you not see yourself now which is the prince and which the tailor? Certainly this Kaftan is a very fine one,
